3. In the GROUP_RE disposition, drop "all 150 roster groups" or re-derive the count from the tree (it is 151 at main). Prefer wording that carries no count.
4. The carry-missing block is the orchestrator's. The two corrected guardrail points (P(X<=4|30,0.28)=0.0495, so the 30-PR arm trips at <=4; any ALPHA is checked at P=0.0526, k=2 of 20) are being appended to R10-ORCH-MACHINERY on the roster batch handoff/audit-r10-roster.
